purpose: Traceable capability/governance research, not campaign-effect evidence

sources.name: SQLite appropriate uses
sources.extracted_information: Local/low write-concurrency embedded storage fits this instance. Keep database access local to its application server.
sources.limits: No load benchmark performed.

sources.name: SQLite WAL
sources.extracted_information: WAL keeps processes on one host/local filesystem. Official page documents WAL-reset fix in3.51.3 or later and selected backports3.44.6/3.50.7.
sources.influence: Runtime gate before WAL, conservative rollback journal fallback
sources.limits: Future runtime must be checked; Python version alone is insufficient.

sources.name: SQLite backup API
sources.extracted_information: Consistent database snapshot API is preferable to copying only a live WAL main file.
sources.limits: Asset/raw-file snapshot consistency needs application coordination.

sources.name: SQLite copyright
sources.extracted_information: SQLite source is public domain; provenance still includes the selected distribution/build.
sources.limits: Does not certify future runtime/driver distribution.

sources.name: Django databases
sources.extracted_information: Django supports SQLite; concurrency/locking differences require explicit conditional writes and short transactions.
sources.influence: Recommended monolith implementation, no PostgreSQL row-lock assumptions
sources.limits: stable URL is a moving documentation target, not a pinned version or ownership audit.

sources.name: Django CSRF
sources.extracted_information: Same-origin browser mutations need CSRF protection independently of app-account scope.
sources.limits: No production security test performed.
